items.title: AI is hollowing out the middle of design, leaving an hourglass behind
items.excerpt: For fifteen years the design process kept growing while the time left for making the product kept shrinking; AI is now compressing the middle of the process into an hourglass shape.

items.title: Secret agent bot: accessibility matters for the agents even if you can't see them
items.excerpt: Two readers, one page: AI agents never see the surface you designed, they read the semantic structure underneath, so accessible markup is now agent UX.

items.title: From a Figma URL to a custom WordPress theme with Claude Code
items.excerpt: The author built figma-wp-blueprint, a set of Claude Code skills that turn a Figma design URL into a custom WordPress theme.

items.title: Beyond WCAG: Can AI Agents Make the Web Truly Adaptive?
items.excerpt: Explores AI agents that adapt websites to individual accessibility needs instead of expecting every user to fit one WCAG-compliant layout.

items.title: Designing a Test Contract for AI Font Interfaces
items.excerpt: An AI font generator looks like a single input and button, but its small surface still needs a test contract covering prompts, glyph output and failure states.

items.title: Google is preparing Nano Banana 3 Pro upgrade
items.excerpt: GemPix 3 Pro has appeared in Google's image citation functionality, hinting at a Nano Banana 3 Pro image model; no public release is confirmed.

items.title: Now AI isn't just faking art, it's faking artists' signatures as well
items.excerpt: ChatGPT has been signing its fake New Yorker-style cartoons with real cartoonists' names, raising new attribution problems for illustrators.

items.title: Epic reportedly delays its Disney video game so it can be made using more AI
items.excerpt: Epic's Disney game is reportedly delayed after developers were ordered to use AI for both code and art asset creation.

items.title: BiteTheBytes unveils World Creator 4
items.excerpt: The terrain generator's big update adds planet creation, a node-based authoring environment, a real-time render engine and an integrated MCP server so AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT can drive it.

items.title: ArtCraft Releases Free Open-Source Adobe Alternatives - FilmCraft for Premiere Pro, EffectCraft for After Effects
items.excerpt: ArtCraft released free, open-source Adobe alternatives rebuilt with AI-assisted reverse engineering, including FilmCraft for Premiere Pro and EffectCraft for After Effects.

items.title: Apple, Content Authenticity, and the War to Prove What's Real
items.excerpt: With AI generators producing photorealistic images of things that never happened, the piece examines Apple's role in content credentials and proving an image is real.

items.title: INSLOGIC and Neural4D launch "From Prompt to Print" campaign linking AI 3D generation with filament printing
items.excerpt: Neural4D's text/image-to-3D generator is paired with INSLOGIC filament in a campaign taking users from an AI prompt to a printable physical model.

items.title: Design System in Code: What It Is and How to Build One
items.excerpt: How a code-first design system compares to Figma-only systems and UI kits, and how to build one that works for designers, developers and AI tools.

items.title: GPT-6's Intelligent UI in ChatGPT: What It Does and How to Use It
items.excerpt: GPT-6's intelligent UI turns ChatGPT text answers into interactive visuals, charts and tappable guides - a generative-UI shift in the chat surface.

items.title: Iris 3B: The Image Generator That Skips Latent Space Entirely
items.excerpt: Iris 3B generates images directly in pixel space with no VAE, and the same weights handle depth estimation and upscaling.

items.title: AI Cloned Photoshop. What's Left of the Software Moat?
items.excerpt: Open-source AI clones of Photoshop show creative software can now be rebuilt by watching it run; what that means for design-tool moats.

items.title: AI-pilled bosses and clients are turning designers into 'pixel pushers'
items.excerpt: Designers say clients and managers now arrive with AI-generated mockups and 'just ask ChatGPT' direction, reducing them to fixing AI output instead of originating ideas.

items.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
items.excerpt: Meta says its new Muse Wonder models compete with the industry's best and will soon power its multimodal Muse agent.

items.title: Real-Time AI Worlds in Focus at Visko and Google Cloud's October 14 LA Fireside Chat
items.excerpt: A Visko and Google Cloud session looks at AI-generated environments that respond to user input while keeping continuity, and what they mean for previs and virtual production.

items.title: FAST Video Voice Dubbing in Multiple Languages with ElevenCreative
items.excerpt: DesignCourse dubs a design demo into Spanish, Tagalog and Vietnamese in his own voice with ElevenLabs, then fixes mistranslated terms line by line.

items.title: Every app on Earth is now open source... whether it likes it or not
items.excerpt: Fireship tests the AI-rebuilt, open-source Rust clones of seven Adobe apps and what AI-driven reimplementation means for creative software.
